is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (including An. gambiae M and S forms, An. arabiensis, and An. melas) collected along the River Gambia (pages 1-6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study only performs molecular species and M/S form identification using PCR-RFLP of rDNA, and ELISA blood-meal analyses; no insecticide resistance markers (such as Vgsc, Ace-1, Rdl, etc.) are genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No insecticide resistance marker genotype or allele data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were field-collected adult females from various sites along the Gambia River in The Gambia and eastern Senegal during 2005 and 2006 (pages 3-6, Table 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field study reporting mosquito collections, species/form identification, and blood meal analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific villages with GPS coordinates are provided in Table 1 (e.g., Kartong 13°05'N, 16°45'W; Mandinaba 13°17'N, 16°35'W).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections were conducted during October-November 2005 and August-October 2006 (pages 2-4, Table 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary entomological survey conducted by MRC Laboratories and Sapienza University.

supplement.evidence: Additional files 1 and 2 only contain monthly rainfall data and landscape analysis, neither of which includes insecticide resistance marker data.

assessment.summary: This study examined the geographic and seasonal distribution of the Anopheles gambiae complex and the M and S molecular forms along a 400 km west-to-east transect following the River Gambia in The Gambia and eastern Senegal in 2005 and 2006. It investigated species/form composition, M/S hybridization rates, and human blood indices, but did not genotype any insecticide resistance markers or conduct bioassays.
